rag.text:
Test: TC-4202 — Box Module - Overview - Column Views - Select DataType columns can have colors assigned
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-59 Box Module - Overview

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Box Configuration of the Root Box > Overview > Box Columns
   Expected: The page loads.
2. Create a new custom column passing the folLowing set of data:
   Data: field name: [TC-4202|https://appfire.atlassian.net/plugins/servlet/ac/com.infostretch.QmetryTestManager/qtm4j-test-management?project.key=TC&project.id=10356#!/TestCaseDetail/qMpouJjGHd4Ggq/1?projectId=10356]

field type: Select

field values:

* option 1
* option 2
   Expected: The column is successfully created.
3. Change the color of option 1 to red, and the color of option 2 to blue.
   Expected: The colors are successfully changed.
4. Navigate to the Overview module of the boxName
   Data: boxName: [TC-4202|https://appfire.atlassian.net/plugins/servlet/ac/com.infostretch.QmetryTestManager/qtm4j-test-management?project.key=TC&project.id=10356#!/TestCaseDetail/qMpouJjGHd4Ggq/1?projectId=10356] Main Box
   Expected: The Overview module loads and the Boxes are displayed.
5. Click on the "Manage columns" cog and add the "[TC-4202|https://appfire.atlassian.net/plugins/servlet/ac/com.infostretch.QmetryTestManager/qtm4j-test-management?project.key=TC&project.id=10356#!/TestCaseDetail/qMpouJjGHd4Ggq/1?projectId=10356]" column to the current view.
   Expected: The column is successfully added to the current view.
6. In the "[TC-4202|https://appfire.atlassian.net/plugins/servlet/ac/com.infostretch.QmetryTestManager/qtm4j-test-management?project.key=TC&project.id=10356#!/TestCaseDetail/qMpouJjGHd4Ggq/1?projectId=10356]" column assign the "option 1" option to the "[TC-4202|https://appfire.atlassian.net/plugins/servlet/ac/com.infostretch.QmetryTestManager/qtm4j-test-management?project.key=TC&project.id=10356#!/TestCaseDetail/qMpouJjGHd4Ggq/1?projectId=10356] Main Box" and the "option 2" to the "[TC-4202|https://appfire.atlassian.net/plugins/servlet/ac/com.infostretch.QmetryTestManager/qtm4j-test-management?project.key=TC&project.id=10356#!/TestCaseDetail/qMpouJjGHd4Ggq/1?projectId=10356] Child Box".
   Expected: The options are successfully assigned to the Boxes. The "option 1" is red and the "option 2" is blue.
